comparison.objective: Compress an overfull case lid and pull its zipper from front to back; candidate breaks and retrieves installed-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained compression plus guided zipper pulling versus one-arm mandrel stabilization, other-arm impact delivery, lateral-force control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Lid remains shut and zipper reaches the back after coordinated manipulation; candidate requires four notch fractures and complete safe containment.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual, but their central coordination and outcomes—continuous closure under compression versus precision impact fracture—are materially different.
